title: Jerk Me Off Chicken
description: This dish is called jerk me off chicken and it's the best chicken recipe I've ever made. Don't fuck it up.

ingredients.item: Two habanero peppers or one scotch bonnet
Two shot glasses worth of soy sauce
Two shot glasses worth of oil
Three tablespoons of maple syrup (or honey)

steps: Blend all the marinade ingredients: nutmeg, brown cloves, cinnamon, brown sugar, green onions, garlic, ginger, habanero peppers or scotch bonnet, lemons, soy sauce, and oil.
Pour 80% of the marinade over the chicken thighs.
Massage the marinade into the chicken and leave it in the fridge for at least a day.
Remove the chicken from the fridge, bring it to room temperature, and place it on a tray.
Roast the chicken in the oven at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes.
Mix the remaining marinade (20%) with three tablespoons of maple syrup (or honey).
Remove the chicken from the oven, brush it with the mixture, and broil for at least 10 minutes, watching to prevent burning.
Serve the chicken with the juices poured over rice, peas, or other side dishes.
notes:
For best results, marinate the chicken overnight.
